highlights: Plus board games and Netflix on a 55-inch Smart TV.
A big, fully fenced back garden that's all yours.
about: Zermatt Lodge is a spacious 4-bedroom house in Liverpool with room for up to 7 guests, made for groups, families and business or contractor stays. There is a king master bedroom with en-suite, a second king, a queen room and a single, plus two bathrooms in total. Downstairs you get a big kitchen, a separate dining room and a games room with a pool table and board games, and the 55-inch Smart TV has Netflix. Out back there is a large private garden, and there is free parking for 2 cars.

Liverpool city centre is about 15 minutes away by train or car, and with free parking you can get around Merseyside easily. Check-in is from 3pm and checkout is by 11am. You book direct here, so you deal with the host, ZALO Stays, from start to finish.

Every stay comes with fresh towels and hotel-quality bedding. The cleaning crew makes sure the house is spotless for every stay, and the local team inspects the property before each arrival. The property management team is available 24/7 by email or phone if you need anything.

faqs.q: How many people does Zermatt Lodge sleep?
faqs.a: Zermatt Lodge sleeps up to 7 guests. It is an entire 4-bedroom house with 4 beds: a king in the master bedroom (with en-suite), a second king, a queen and a single.

faqs.q: How many bedrooms and bathrooms are there?
faqs.a: There are 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The king master bedroom has its own en-suite, and there is a second bathroom for the other three bedrooms.

faqs.q: Is it the entire house or a shared space?
faqs.a: You get the entire house to yourselves, all four bedrooms, both bathrooms, the kitchen, dining room, games room and the large private back garden. Nothing is shared with other guests.

faqs.q: Where is Zermatt Lodge?
faqs.a: Zermatt Lodge is a 4-bedroom house in Liverpool, Merseyside. Liverpool city centre is about 15 minutes away by train or car. The full address is sent to confirmed guests.

faqs.q: Is the house in Liverpool city centre?
faqs.a: No. Zermatt Lodge is a residential house in Liverpool, not in the city centre. The city centre is about 15 minutes away by train or car, so it suits guests who want more space, a garden and free parking with an easy trip into town.

faqs.q: Is it close to Aintree University Hospital?
faqs.a: Many guests stay while visiting a Liverpool hospital, including Aintree University Hospital. Free parking for 2 cars means you can drive to the hospital, or you can use Merseyrail.

faqs.q: How far is it from The Walton Centre?
faqs.a: The Walton Centre shares the Aintree University Hospital site on Lower Lane. Free parking at the house means you can drive there, or use Merseyrail.

faqs.q: Is there parking?
faqs.a: Yes, there is free parking for 2 cars at the house. That is useful for hospital visits, as hospital parking in Liverpool is chargeable.

faqs.q: How do I get to Liverpool city centre?
faqs.a: Liverpool city centre is about 15 minutes away by train or car. Merseyrail takes contactless cards and phones: tap in and tap out.

faqs.q: Is it good for the Grand National?
faqs.a: Yes. It sleeps 7 with free parking for 2 cars, and Aintree station runs extra trains on race days. The 2027 Grand National Festival runs 8-10 April 2027, so book early as it is the busiest week of the year.

faqs.q: Is it close to Anfield and Everton's stadium?
faqs.a: It isn't walking distance to either ground. For both, take the train to Sandhills: Everton fans walk from there, and the matchday Soccerbus runs to Anfield.

faqs.q: What time are check-in and check-out?
faqs.a: Check-in is from 3pm and check-out is by 11am.

faqs.q: Is Zermatt Lodge good group accommodation in Liverpool?
faqs.a: Yes. It is a whole 4-bedroom house in Liverpool that sleeps 7, with a games room, a big kitchen, a separate dining room, a private garden and free parking for 2 cars, so a group can stay together under one roof instead of booking several hotel rooms.

faqs.q: Is it contractor accommodation in Liverpool?
faqs.a: Yes. Contractors and work crews book Zermatt Lodge for weekly and monthly stays: 4 bedrooms with separate beds, free parking for 2 cars and a washing machine and tumble dryer. Email cs@zugati.co.uk for longer stays.

faqs.q: Is the house suitable for contractors and work crews?
faqs.a: Yes. It sleeps 7 across 4 bedrooms, has free parking for 2 cars, a big kitchen and a dining room, and the motorway network makes it easy to get around Merseyside and the North West.

faqs.q: Do you take longer stays for work crews?
faqs.a: Yes. Email cs@zugati.co.uk for weekly and monthly stays.

faqs.q: Is it good for families and groups?
faqs.a: Yes. There is a games room with a pool table, board games, a 55" Smart TV with Netflix, a big kitchen, a separate dining room and a large private back garden.

faqs.q: What entertainment is there?
faqs.a: The games room has a pool table, there are board games for all ages, and the living area has a 55" Smart TV with Netflix.

faqs.q: Can we have a party or event?
faqs.a: No. Strictly no parties or events, bookings found to be for parties are cancelled. Zermatt Lodge is a home in a residential area for families, groups and work stays, so please respect the neighbours.

faqs.q: Is smoking allowed?
faqs.a: No. Smoking is not allowed anywhere in the house.

faqs.q: Are pets allowed?
faqs.a: No, pets are not allowed.

faqs.q: What do I need to provide before my stay?
faqs.a: All guests booking need to provide ID, sign a rental agreement, and either pay a damage deposit or take the damage waiver. The host will ask for these after you book.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.a: The cancellation policy is Moderate: you get a full refund if you cancel up to 5 days before check-in, a 50% refund if you cancel after that, and no refund after check-in. No pets and no smoking. Strictly no parties or events, bookings found to be for parties are cancelled. Guest ID and damage deposit may be required.

faqs.q: Is Zermatt Lodge also on Airbnb and Booking.com?
faqs.a: Yes. The same house is also listed on Airbnb and Booking.com. Booking direct on this website means you deal with the hosts and avoid their guest service fees.

faqs.q: How do I book?
faqs.a: You can book directly on this website, choose your dates in the booking section and pay securely by card. Booking direct means you deal with the host, ZALO Stays, from start to finish.

faqs.q: Why book direct instead of Airbnb?
faqs.a: Same house, same team, but no platform service fee. Payment is taken securely online by card, and you deal with the host from start to finish.

faqs.q: Who runs Zermatt Lodge?
faqs.a: Zermatt Lodge is run by ZALO Stays. You can email cs@zugati.co.uk or send a message when you book.

faqs.q: Are there shops nearby?
faqs.a: Yes. There are supermarkets a short drive away, and delivery apps and supermarket home delivery cover the area.

faqs.q: How far is Liverpool John Lennon Airport?
faqs.a: Most guests drive or take a taxi from Liverpool John Lennon Airport; by public transport you can go via the city centre.

faqs.q: Are there parks nearby?
faqs.a: Yes. Liverpool has plenty of green space, including Croxteth Hall and Country Park with a working farm, a walled garden and a free Saturday parkrun.
